params.prompt:
Image 1 is the scene. Keep it exactly as it is — same camera, same framing, same small cloud creature in the same spot, same rack, counter and every other fixture, same paper and palette.

Change ONE thing: a big flat screen has popped straight out of the LEFT side of the tall black server rack on a hinged metal arm, and now hangs out over the coffee counter at the height of the rack's upper half, tilted a little towards us. The screen is lit and flooded edge to edge with dense scrolling lines of code, drawn as the film draws code: row upon row of small graphite dashes and short blocks, indented like program listings, packed so tight the screen reads as a solid wall of text, with a soft pale glow on the wall around it. A thick cable runs from the screen back into the rack.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, visible construction lines, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash on props only, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no photographic lighting, no 3D. Do not add any legible text or letters.
